content.title: Chapter 66 - PARKS AND RECREATION — Sec. 66-24. - Vehicle speed limit.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to drive or ride a motorized vehicle, where otherwise
               permitted, in any public park at a speed greater than 15 miles per hour.
(Code 1960, § 17-27(A); Code 1981, § 22-5)
